descriptive: user 2026-11-26 ~18:50 in writeup-lead's chat: "tell whip-lead to run 1 and 2. as you suggest, put in appendix G unless it works well"; two cheap proxies reported per task and seed beside their random references, no verdict on reuse, no claim at the bar

settings.sae_size_source: E234's scored SAEs, seed 0, at all 13 sites (experiments/sae_train/results/large/scored/sae_<site>_s0.pt), loaded as E245 (sae_r_a load_saes)
settings.norm_rows_source: Kissane et al. estimate each model's norm factor on Pile activations (their activation store, SAELens expected_average_only_in: mean norm sqrt(d_model)); 128 Pile val rows from E234's eval_start 4096 at positions 1.. = 65,408 tokens, inside their 50k-100k eval tokens
settings.outlier_threshold_source: sae-transfer utils.py get_explained_variance_from_batch default outlier_threshold=100_000, applied to the norm of each token in their scale (mean norm sqrt(d)); the post says outliers were excluded from the evals
settings.gain_floor_source: E136's two-sided gain floor on the trained states (card floor line); a trained state under it gives nan
settings.random_gain_min_source: the card's floor: a random reference's error share only if |gain| >= 1 log-odds (local_faith.MIN_GAIN, where shares are scored), else null with the reason
settings.gain_rel_tol_source: the plan's stage 0: T1 - T0 against E136's saved gain_fp32 per state at relative 0.01 (same rows, model and fp32 path; a wrong-rows error is far larger)
settings.e234_fve_tol_source: E234's own do_nothing_tol (sae_train predictions.json): the bar for the same weights read by the same bf16 code; E234's do-nothing item read fve_drop exactly 0 at all 14 SAEs (measured floor 0 on its card), so 1e-3 leaves room only for another card's bf16 kernels

states: the 48 states of experiments/known_3seeds/results/known3.json cells with method share (16 tasks x seeds 0-2; e54/elicit and c3/cipher shared by two pairs, read once); side = reuse for the pair's first task (known_3seeds assemble.py PAIRS), new for the second
random_reference: one per state: finetune.random_direction(dW, seed), a Gaussian per matrix at that matrix's Frobenius norm in the state's update (fp64 norms, E237's convention), seed = int(sha256(state name)[:8], 16); read on the state's own rows

error_share.definition: (L_patch - T0) / (T1 - T0) in mean log-odds of the target on E136's rows; L_patch = base model with each of the 8 block-output sites set to hat(o_cur) + e_FT, all at once
error_share.control: full patch (o_FT at all 8 sites) reproduces T1: max |logit - FT logit| at the read position within the measured run-to-run floor (share 1)
error_share.random: gain ~0, share not read (null when |gain| < 1 log-odds)
error_share.blind_to: error that cancels across sites or positions before the read position; changes the SAE latents absorb (a fine-tune inside the dictionary reads 0 whether or not it reuses)

error_energy_frac.definition: sum over the 8 sites and every position of |e_FT - e_0|^2 over |o_FT - o_0|^2, each model's own run
error_energy_frac.trained_if_rival_a: reuse below random, new near random
error_energy_frac.blind_to: whether the changed energy matters for the target (size-free, not behaviour-weighted)

ev_gap.definition: headline of reading (2), Kissane et al. 2024: EV(base) - EV(FT) per site of E234's 13, EV per token 1 - |SAE(x) - x|^2 / |x - mean x|^2 averaged over the task rows' positions 1.., each model scaled by its own Pile norm factor, outliers over the threshold excluded; mean over the 13 sites
ev_gap.blind_to: anything the base dictionary reconstructs as well after the update (a change along existing latents); a global norm change (removed by the per-model norm factor)

fvu_gap.definition: secondary: FVU(FT) - FVU(base), FVU a ratio of sums over the task rows' positions 1.. (sae.read's convention), no rescaling; mean over the 13 sites

stage0.rule: first and alone; any miss writes results/results.json stage0.stopped, prints STOP and exits 1 before any state is read
stage0.zero_update: on the first state's rows: gain 0, error share nan, max |e_FT - e_0| = 0, energy numerator = 0 and fraction nan, L_patch - T0 = 0, max |EV gap| = 0 and max |FVU gap| = 0 over 13 sites, all exactly
stage0.run_to_run_floor: the first state's fine-tuned model run twice: max |logit| difference at the read position (measured, the full patch's tolerance)
stage0.full_patch: o_FT at all 8 sites in the base model: max |logit - FT logit| at the read position <= the floor
stage0.e234_fve: E234's base FVE on its Pile val rows 4096-4607 by its own bf16 capture (sae.capture) and sae.read's formula, per site within e234_fve_tol of stage0_resid_pre0_s0+13.json; the fp32 FVE on the same rows recorded beside, no stop
stage0.gain: every state's T1 - T0 within gain_rel_tol relative of its saved gain_fp32 (share_untrained stage1.json .states.<s>.gain_fp32; known_3seeds stage2.json and refit_96key stage1.json .states.<s>.e136.gain_fp32); the job stops naming each state missed

not_a_verdict: the readings are plotted per task and seed beside the random reference against the re-gating share (known3.json); writeup-lead decides placement
